claims_extracted: The strategy implementation defines XAUUSD enhanced momentum persistence using ROC/SMA direction, ADX trend confirmation, and Chandelier-style exits.
XAUUSD is present in the FTMO terminal universe snapshot as a Metals CFD symbol, making the hypothesis MT5/FTMO-relevant but not terminal-equivalent yet.
The configured route uses XAUUSD M15 research data from 2018-2025 and must be judged only by pre-registered WFA evidence.
limitations: Source support is repo-local implementation/config/data plus terminal-universe evidence, not independent external research.
The XAUUSD research CSV is not proven equivalent to FTMO MT5 terminal history; classify as mt5_relevant_unverified.
Gold CFD session hours, spreads, swap/roll behavior, and broker-specific contract details can materially alter MT5 parity.
disconfirming_relevance: Gold trend persistence can reverse sharply around macro events and fail on range-bound samples.
A momentum route can overfit to parameter windows despite trend-following intuition.
A structural MT5-relevant route still fails if WFA return, trade count, or OOS consistency floors are not met.
